## Summary

- land accepted Phase 27 Breakdown, Pool, and Staging interaction adapters and realizations
- preserve authoritative Add/Delete/Edit and Stage/Unstage lifetimes, recovery, focus, and one-shot signals
- archive Phase 27, resolve P23-02, and retain P27-06/P27-08 as explicit deferrals

## Validation

- pnpm test - 95 files / 982 tests
- pnpm lint - 0 errors / 11 pre-existing warnings
- pnpm typecheck
- pnpm build - seven pages generated
- git diff --check and exact-main merge-tree passed in the detached close preview
- user-run bounded canonical-route Phase 27 smoke, including P27-12/P27-13 repair rechecks - green with no additional finding; accepted task edge, cross-tab, eight-theme, and reduced-motion evidence reused
